thread:

emma: ```

context: kvcache.eviction timeout
stack: ...
```
raj: On it. Are canaries pinned to the new kernel/quant profile? If yes, rollback to previous model variant.
sam: Customer impact look: a subset of EU customers behind a specific POP saw increased failures. CS pinged about degraded responses. No broad-tier outages yet.
leah: Recommending immediate traffic cut to 0 for canary group and flip feature flag ff/new-infer-path -> off. That should stop traffic to new path.
charlie: Running flag toggle via admin API now: `POST /flags/ff/new-infer-path{enabled:false}`
charlie: ✅ flag toggle accepted. Confirming requests to canary backend dropping.
emma: 5xx rate falling but still a bit noisy. Need a full rollback of the release to be safe.
raj: Starting rollback job: `infractl rollout rollback --cluster canary-west --release r2026-03-15-2 --to r2026-03-14-9` — running
ops-bot: Rollback job queued, agents assigned: infra-job-4821.
sre_lead: Good. Also set autoscale min to maintain capacity for traffic to stable. If canary decision logic still routes, create routing override.
leah: Override applied: routing policy set to route-canary=false across global router. `curl -XPOST /routing/overrides -d '{"route-canary": false}'`
sam: Customer impact update: CS reports a handful of degraded sessions; no orders lost but higher latency and errors for ~10 customers for ~12m window. We're proactively reaching out.
raj: Rollback completed on canary-west. Deploy reverted to r2026-03-14-9. Health checks greening.
emma: Confirming metrics: error-rate back to baseline within 4m of rollback. Streaming latency normalized.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-12 auto-updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, duration=00:18:21
charlie: Marking the rollout as aborted and revoking the canary job to avoid requeue.
leah: Preparing playbook notes and initial RCA items: reproduce on staging, compare kernel/quant profiles, KV cache latency map.
sre_lead: Handoff to follow-up oncall for postmortem and customer comms. @ops-bot please create postmortem doc and assign.

emma: Thanks everyone — adding logs, perf traces, and sample requests to the postmortem. We'll triage tomorrow and schedule a rollback root cause pairing.
raj: FYI, we'll add a stricter canary abort threshold for model-proxy 5xx (reduce window to 2m and lower percent) so this path trips faster next time.
charlie: Handoff: I'm leaving and handing to @sam (next oncall). Sam, I added runbook steps and who to call if it recurs.
sam: Got it. I'll monitor the follow-up dashboards and coordinate CS updates. Closing thread until postmortem items are assigned. :white_check_mark:
